## Translation prototype tooling

This manually maintained map supplements the older generated catalog above.
It describes repository tooling, not the availability of translated public
pages. Keep the `i18n` detector: it supports the exact-pair translation workflow
and is not a browser translation engine.

| Stage | Current entry point | What it establishes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Detect missing or stale pages | [okhp3-i18n-page-sync](okhp3-i18n-page-sync/SKILL.md), called by `.github/workflows/i18n-page-sync.yml` | Source/target drift for explicitly configured routes. Without `i18n/sync.config.json`, it reports `configured: false` and exits successfully without translating anything. |
| Prepare and review a translation | One of the five exact-pair skills below | A source-faithful draft and mechanical checks. Language quality and publication still require the relevant review evidence. |
| Plan and validate artifacts | Each pair's `scripts/plan-en-us-to-<pair>.py` and `scripts/validate-en-us-to-<pair>.py` | Read-only artifact planning, protected-content parity, and distinct source/target safeguards. These are the canonical helper filenames. |
| Run package regressions | Each pair's `tests/test_en_us_to_<pair>.py` | Discoverable tests of the canonical helpers. Run `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s <skill-directory>/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v`. |

The exact source/target pairs remain separate:

- [United States English to Germany German](okhp3-translation-en-us-de-de/SKILL.md)
- [United States English to British English](okhp3-translation-en-us-en-uk/SKILL.md)
- [United States English to Spain Spanish](okhp3-translation-en-us-es-es/SKILL.md)
- [United States English to Mexico Spanish](okhp3-translation-en-us-es-mx/SKILL.md)
- [United States English to France French](okhp3-translation-en-us-fr-fr/SKILL.md)

The September 5 consolidation preserves the stronger hyphenated helpers and
moves their complete regression coverage into discoverable underscore-named
test files. Older duplicate helper implementations are not alternate entry
points. Dated benchmark records remain historical; see the
[cleanup evidence](../../assets/docs/translation-cleanup-2026-09-05/translation-tooling-audit.md)
for the filename mapping and known prototype limitations before enabling a
locale pilot.

The whole catalog is still stale: a read-only check discovers 65 skills while
the generated block lists 14. Regeneration is blocked by the unrelated duplicate
`okhp3-repl-repo-janitor copy` package. This translation cleanup does not remove
that package or hand-edit the generated block.
